description: Smoke coverage for a pinned income instance whose release declares the income-domain-v2 contract (spec 2026-09-14, calculation worksheet). Version 4 is version 2 plus one required pointer on each paystub-bearing case: /findings/domain/borrowers/0/sources/0/computed/basis. That member is written by the engine, never by the model, and exists only when the model declared schemaVersion income-domain-v2 and the enricher ran, so its presence proves the release produces calculator-labelled monthly figures and a worksheet. Presence, not a particular value: CALCULATOR, MODEL_STATED and NONE are all correct answers for some fixture, and a gate that demanded CALCULATOR would refuse a correct release on a paystub that omits its pay frequency and period. Versions 1 and 2 are left unchanged so every historical report digest stays reproducible; version 3 stays unallowlisted for its own subjectKey reason. Every package named here is a synthetic fixture; no expected borrower value appears anywhere in this file.
